metadata.name: marketing_performance
metadata.comment:
Recommended ad-level consumption view: active rows only. CTR is a fraction, CPC/CPM use the row currency. Zero/unknown denominators yield null.
Collation: UTF8_BINARY
View Text: (
    select *,
 case when impressions > 0 and clicks is not null then cast(clicks as double) / impressions end as ctr,
 case when clicks > 0 then cast(spend as double) / clicks end as cpc,
 case when impressions > 0 then cast(spend as double) / impressions * 1000 end as cpm
from `marketing_prod`.`marketing_marts`.`fct_marketing_spend` where not is_deleted
  )
View Schema Mode: COMPENSATION

metadata.name: rpt_campaign_daily
metadata.comment:
Campaign/day/account/platform/currency reporting view. Country is aggregated away. Complete totals and ratios are null when required inputs are incomplete; known_* columns show partial observations, not complete totals.
Collation: UTF8_BINARY
View Text: (
    with totals as (
 select date_day, platform, account_id, campaign_id, campaign_key, campaign_name, currency_code,
 count(*) as source_rows, sum(spend) as spend,
 sum(impressions) as known_impressions, sum(clicks) as known_clicks,
 sum(case when impressions is null then 1 else 0 end) as unknown_impression_rows,
 sum(case when clicks is null then 1 else 0 end) as unknown_click_rows,
 case when count(impressions) = count(*) then sum(impressions) end as impressions,
 case when count(clicks) = count(*) then sum(clicks) end as clicks
 from `marketing_prod`.`marketing_marts`.`marketing_performance`
 group by date_day, platform, account_id, campaign_id, campaign_key, campaign_name, currency_code
)
select *,
 case when impressions > 0 and clicks is not null then cast(clicks as double)/impressions end as ctr,
 case when clicks > 0 then cast(spend as double)/clicks end as cpc,
 case when impressions > 0 then cast(spend as double)/impressions * 1000 end as cpm
from totals
  )
View Schema Mode: COMPENSATION
View Catalog and Namespace: marketing_prod.marketing
View Query Output Columns: [`date_day`, `platform`, `account_id`, `campaign_id`, `campaign_key`, `campaign_name`, `currency_code`, `source_rows`, `spend`, `known_impressions`, `known_clicks`, `unknown_impression_rows`, `unknown_click_rows`, `impressions`, `clicks`, `ctr`, `cpc`, `cpm`]

 nullif(nullif(trim(cast(ad_currency_code as string)), ''), 'null') as ad_currency_code,
 try_cast(nullif(nullif(trim(cast(account_updated_at as string)), ''), 'null') as timestamp) as updated_at,
 _row_hash
 from 

(select * from `marketing_dev`.`bronze`.`raw__facebook_accounts`
 where _batch_id =
 
   (select batch_id from `marketing_dev`.`bronze`.`active_batch` where dataset = 'marketing')

), ranked as (
 select *, row_number() over (partition by account_id order by updated_at desc nulls last, _row_hash desc) as _rn

)

  )
